caption:
Lake County is now using AI to listen to every emergency medical 911 call, aiming for faster insights.

The technology transcribes each call, flags oddities, and helps spot misclassifications before they become problems 🚑.

If it works, other counties might follow—what do you think about AI policing our emergency lines?
